notes.title: End of July, early August News Update
notes.content:
With August just around the corner, I am getting prepped for productivity to increase again. Defiantly looking forward to getting my student license of adobe again, I almost bought another art class with it starting August 23rd, which means free till June license again. Nothing much happened. I redid one char design; her old outfit was a bit much; joys of using premade commercial assets, most the outfits for females are made for pin-up calendars, more or less.

Kipps new look, the last one, was way too BDSM for my liking more of a placeholder; I love her new look.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42613454/cf9a288b079b4a811cbb32ef2fbdbb1cd65dcb20.png[/img]

Minus, I have been messing, learning the 3d program more, and improving with RPG Maker MZ. For instance, I made this while experimenting with chars. I reached for the game CG.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42613454/ce81ed8048a86dd8f7bda9904ab0137f9b1a4bce.png[/img]
Friendly, fun, inspirational image, and once I get adobe back, I will probably be retexturing that sign at some point as an experiment with the 3d render program for other updates, as well as changing out poses and swapping around chars as the game continues.

But to sum it up, subsequent months' productivity should go back up; I did way more on this when I was in college than in summer break. Plus, that adobe license will significantly help me; everything on the store page I edited with Krita is not a lousy program, but I know adobe better; plus, I miss adobe illustrator. But yeah can't have to wait till the end of the next post. Anything good? Not sure the license will kick back in. I already started paying for classes this month, But no art class till the 23rd. But at any rate, I hope you guys had a fun summer; defiantly to heat is going away.
